verdict.rationale: Firebase automations are Cloud Functions written as code and deployed from the command line (firebase-docs-7, firebase-docs-8, firebase-gh-1). That implies versioning through external source control. The Local Emulator Suite and Test SDK let you review and test changes without touching production (firebase-docs-9, firebase-docs-24, firebase-docs-31). Missing for 10: any first-party versioning or revision history for functions or automations, a built-in review/approval workflow, a documented rollback mechanism, and independent corroboration.
